extraction.name: Instruction-Following Eval (IFEval)
extraction.description: IFEval is an evaluation benchmark designed to assess the instruction-following capabilities of large language models. It consists of around 500 prompts, with each prompt containing one or more objectively verifiable instructions from a set of 25 identified types.
extraction.creator: Jeffrey Zhou; Tianjian Lu; Swaroop Mishra; Siddhartha Brahma; Sujoy Basu; Yi Luan; Denny Zhou; Le Hou
extraction.citeAs: Jeffrey Zhou, Tianjian Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Siddhartha Brahma, Sujoy Basu, Yi Luan, Denny Zhou, Le Hou. Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models. 2023.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset of prompts was created through a four-step process: generating base prompts with randomly selected verifiable instructions, using few-shot prompting to identify and remove illogical prompts, using few-shot prompting to rephrase the prompts for diversity, and finally manually checking and editing the rephrased prompts one by one.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Base prompts generated via few-shot prompting, and model responses scraped from GPT-4 and PaLM 2 S via API calls.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Very few instructions are 100% verifiable objectively and automatically as there always exist edge cases; the loose instruction-following verification process is likely to introduce false positives; the current implementation needs increased diversity and quantity of verifiable instructions; lacks multi-modal use cases.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Discrepancies or misunderstandings in following instructions can lead to unintended outputs, which might have dire results, especially in crucial scenarios like healthcare or autonomous systems.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the instruction-following ability of large language models; comparing different large language models on various instruction types.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Base prompts were generated by appending one to three randomly selected verifiable instructions to the end of each prompt. A few-shot prompting approach was then applied to rephrase each prompt to increase the diversity of phrasing.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Illogical prompts were identified and removed using few-shot prompting, and the rephrased prompts were manually checked and edited one by one.
